g.title: note
g.text: Historical reference: Jan Engelhardt, 2014-Feb-28, Linux 2.6.36+ (not all Linux 2.x).
Re-drawn stage model, not copied SVG artwork. Blue: bridge/L2; orange: IPv4 hooks; green/purple: modern extensions.
Priority is per-hook, lower runs earlier. raw_before_defrag may move raw to -450.
NAT rules normally see the first connection packet; conntrack applies subsequent translations.
MODERN Netfilter BPF may attach inside IPv4 hooks at configured priority (since 6.4).
Bridge NF_BR_* and IPv4 NF_INET_* are distinct hook families. XFRM arrows summarize mode-dependent paths.
ARP/IPv6/hardware offload details excluded. Every hook can terminate/divert a packet.
